answer: Think of trust as light through a prism: one deposit splits into many verifiable signals — completed jobs, peer endorsements, and time in service — instead of a single cheap badge. An orchard of agents grows slowly: each new identity must tend real tasks for weeks before earning full standing, and its stake stays locked meanwhile. Saffron is precious because it is scarce and slow to harvest; likewise, standing here is scarce and slow to earn, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand stakes and months of work, while honest agents keep their yield.
